annotations.text:
AI-Learning-Hub redesign — pick a direction.
Three genuinely different takes on the same content (your real 9 topics, first module, empty recall ledger). Choose one and the full screen set (module reader, ledger, topic pages) gets built in that language, then implemented as the real GitHub Pages site.

A — Skill Constellation. Explore-by-map: topics are stars, progress is light, prerequisites are lines.
Motivation: the whole curriculum visible as one sky; progress feels like igniting a galaxy.
Tradeoff: the map needs care as modules grow; least conventional to navigate.

B — The AI Atlas. Warm editorial expedition: camp → ridge → summit per territory, a route map for the phases, flags for recall passes.
Motivation: strongest storytelling; makes learning feel like a journey, very approachable for future learners.
Tradeoff: least dense — more scrolling to see everything.

C — Mission Control. Measurement-first dashboard: skill radar, recall heat, topic ladders, module queue.
Motivation: embodies the hub doctrine (measure or it didn't happen); densest at-a-glance state.
Tradeoff: most tool-like, least narrative warmth.
Progress visuals show illustrative future state (bars, radar, one heat cell) — the real site renders only what the ledger actually contains.
